rows.mahanadi_coalfields_limited_mcl_burla_od: Post Diploma Practical Training (PDPT) - Mining Discipline
Diploma in Mining Engineering passed during or after 2022; registered on NATS 2.0 portal with a valid Student Enrolment Number; open only to sons/daughters of MCL employees, ex-employees and PAPs
Office of the General Manager (HRD), MCL HQ, P.O. Anand Vihar, Burla, Dist. Sambalpur - 768020 (Odisha)

content_sections.heading: MCL Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. MCL(HQ)/GM(HRD)/PDPT/2026-27/1394 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download MCL notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Diploma in Mining Engineering passed during or after 2022; Registered on the NATS 2.0 portal as per BOPT guidelines with a valid Student Enrolment Number; Son/Daughter of an MCL Employee / Ex-Employee / Project Affected Person (PAP) Other conditions: Open exclusively to Sons/Daughters of MCL Employees / Ex-Employees / PAPs Seats: 80% for wards of Employees / Ex-Employees, 20% for wards of PAPs; vacant seats interchangeable

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for MCL Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Direct applications shall not be entertained

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Post Diploma Practical Training for a period of one year under the Apprentice Act, 1961 Deployment through the NATS 2.0 portal Training offer letters issued for different underground mines of MCL after BOPT (ER), Kolkata approval

rows.event: Last date for submission of applications at Area/HQ level
Applications to reach office of General Manager (HRD), MCL HQ (by 05:00 PM)

content_sections.heading: How Will MCL Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Candidates who passed earlier preferred over those who passed later Among candidates passing in the same year, higher marks preferred In case of a tie, candidate senior in age preferred List of selected candidates forwarded to BOPT (ER), Kolkata for approval Training offer letters issued after approval Earlier year of passing gets preference Same year of passing: higher marks preferred Tie: candidate senior in age preferred

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Matriculation Certificate and Diploma Certificate Mark sheets (Matriculation and Diploma) Passport-size photograph (2 nos.) Aadhaar Card and Caste Certificate, if any NATS Portal Registration (Student Valid Enrolment Number) and Photo Identity Card with address Identity proof: MCL Photo ID Card / Certificate for employees/ex-employees; Photo ID Card & Certificate from concerned Area for PAPs

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for MCL Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Download the prescribed application form and checklist from the MCL website (www.mahanadicoal.in). Fill in the form completely and attach self-attested copies of the listed documents. Submit the application at the office of the Area HR Manager (AHRM) of the concerned Area, routed through the Area General Manager. HQ candidates route the application through GM (HR-IR/NEE), MCL HQ. Submit on or before 27.11.2026; direct applications shall not be entertained.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: All self-attested documents verified with originals by the office of the Area HR Manager before forwarding Applications must reach GM (HRD), MCL HQ on or before 30.11.2026 by 05:00 PM

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for MCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 27 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How do I apply for MCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (MCL website (www.mahanadicoal.in); application format and checklist enclosed with the notice) and send it to Office of the General Manager (HRD), MCL HQ, P.O. Anand Vihar, Burla, Dist. Sambalpur - 768020 (Odisha), by submitted at the office of the ahrm of the concerned area (through area gm), or through gm (hr-ir/nee), mcl hq for hq candidates, to reach by 27 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for MCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Diploma in Mining Engineering passed during or after 2022; registered on NATS 2.0 portal with a valid Student Enrolment Number; open only to sons/daughters of MCL employees, ex-employees and PAPs.

faq.question: Q4. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Open exclusively to Sons/Daughters of MCL Employees / Ex-Employees / PAPs. Seats: 80% for wards of Employees / Ex-Employees, 20% for wards of PAPs; vacant seats interchangeable.

faq.question: Q5. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Direct applications shall not be entertained.

faq.question: Q6. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates who passed earlier preferred over those who passed later. Among candidates passing in the same year, higher marks preferred. In case of a tie, candidate senior in age preferred. List of selected candidates forwarded to BOPT (ER), Kolkata for approval.

faq.question: Q7. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Post Diploma Practical Training for a period of one year under the Apprentice Act, 1961. Deployment through the NATS 2.0 portal. Training offer letters issued for different underground mines of MCL after BOPT (ER), Kolkata approval.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Underground mines of MCL.

faq.question: Q9. Which documents are needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Matriculation Certificate and Diploma Certificate; Mark sheets (Matriculation and Diploma); Passport-size photograph (2 nos.); Aadhaar Card and Caste Certificate, if any; NATS Portal Registration (Student Valid Enrolment Number) and Photo Identity Card with address; Identity proof: MCL Photo ID Card / Certificate for employees/ex-employees; Photo ID Card & Certificate from concerned Area for PAPs.
